milestones.title: v0.1 — Usable local research workflow
milestones.description: Installable skill, evidence-linked map contract, offline interactive viewer, grounded draft example, reproducible tests and first release. Software readiness does not imply scientific certification.

milestones.title: v0.2 — Simple inputs and readable research histories
milestones.description: Skill-first topic/paper intake, bounded discovery, proposal gates, calm progressive reading, bilingual documentation, temporal proposals and reproducible evaluation tools.

milestones.title: External validation — independent review and user study
milestones.description: Requires real consenting participants and actual observations. Software fixtures and agent self-checks do not close this milestone.

issues.title: Define an honest product baseline and release scope
issues.problem: The supplied plans combine a small local tool with unstaffed expert certification and describe unavailable artifacts as complete.
issues.deliverable: Publish a source-grounded design, product audit, and 28-task disposition with a separate software release gate.
issues.acceptance: Read docs/product-audit.md, docs/design/research-lineage.md, and docs/roadmap.md. Every RL-001 through RL-028 must have a disposition and no prior test counts may be presented as current results.
issues.negative: An unavailable expert review or user study must remain future work.

issues.title: Validate version-bound results and evidence
issues.problem: A valid JSON object can still falsely imply scientific inheritance or bind evidence to the wrong paper revision.
issues.deliverable: Implement the canonical map schema and deterministic reference, date, review, comparability, and dependency checks.
issues.acceptance: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_contract.py -q`. Valid sample passes with review warnings. All specified invalid maps fail with actionable diagnostics.
issues.negative: A citation-only generalization, abstract-only reviewed claim, version mismatch, or unknown-setting improvement must fail.

issues.title: Build deterministic portable research bundles
issues.problem: A beautiful map is not shareable if it requires an account, external runtime assets, or silently drops evidence.
issues.deliverable: Build map.html, map.svg, map.json, and review.md; preserve scope, versions, uncertainties, and source links. Provide comparison and revision diff.
issues.acceptance: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_workflow.py -q` and `python -m research_lineage demo --out output/acceptance`. Repeated builds in distinct directories must be byte-identical.
issues.negative: Reject unsafe links, malicious executable markup, oversized input, empty drafts, and output paths that overwrite input maps.
issues.original: RL-003, RL-020 (diff only), RL-021 (proposal only), RL-023

issues.title: Deliver an inspectable and accessible map experience
issues.problem: Researchers need to understand the story and check a connection without reading raw JSON.
issues.deliverable: Implement chronology lanes, evidence inspection, settings comparison, a reading route, search/filters, reading list, and offline exports.
issues.acceptance: Build the demo, open map.html, click a result and a relationship, compare two settings, complete route navigation, and export HTML/SVG/JSON. Verify keyboard access and a 390 px viewport; record observations in docs/verification.md.
issues.negative: Zero search hits must show an actionable empty state. Filtering must not silently remove results from exported data. A recorded review must not be labeled authenticated.

issues.title: Ground the QSP/QSVT example in primary sources
issues.problem: The existing prototype is an abstract-level draft, not a source-complete or expert-reviewed gold standard.
issues.deliverable: Recheck each included primary record and version. Preserve result settings, targeted critiques, coverage omissions, and proposed status.
issues.acceptance: Run `python -m research_lineage validate src/research_lineage/data/qsp-qsvt.json`. Cross-check all eight versioned URLs and dates in docs/sources.md. The example contains eight results and six evidence-linked relations.
issues.negative: Do not promote a result to reviewed, infer dates from an arXiv ID, or present a critique as refuting an entire field.

issues.title: Package a self-contained research-lineage skill
issues.problem: A SKILL.md that depends on a missing checkout cannot be installed and used reliably.
issues.deliverable: Ship a host-neutral skill, data guide, behavioral cases, and a ZIP with the canonical Python runtime and example.
issues.acceptance: Run `python scripts/package_skill.py --out dist` and `python -m pytest tests/test_workflow.py -k isolated -q`. Extract elsewhere and run `python -I <extracted>/research-lineage/scripts/lineage.py demo --out <new-output>`.
issues.negative: A copied SKILL.md without runtime must not claim installation success. A new user question must create an empty draft, not silently substitute the bundled example.

issues.title: Verify and publish the first usable release
issues.problem: A repository without working installation, evidence of tests, and an immediate demo does not deliver the first user outcome.
issues.deliverable: Provide English README/docs, Apache-2.0 license, Windows/Linux CI, coverage, portable artifacts, and a v0.1.0 GitHub release.
issues.acceptance: Run Ruff, pytest with coverage, `python -m build`, and the isolated skill test. Confirm CI passes on Python 3.11 and 3.14 on Windows and Linux. Attach the wheel, skill ZIP, and offline demo ZIP to the release.
issues.negative: Do not claim expert review, automated discovery, two-host certification, or a promised star count. Do not ship caches, credentials, or source PDFs.

issues.title: Add bounded discovery with auditable failure states
issues.problem: Host research tools are currently the only retrieval route; provider behavior is not captured in a reusable log.
issues.deliverable: Add a no-paid-default Crossref/arXiv adapter with explicit candidate/request limits, pagination, query logs, and partial-result status.
issues.acceptance: Implement and run `python -m pytest tests/test_discovery.py -q`. A fixture with two pages and a candidate cap must stop at the cap, preserving queries, timestamps, truncation, and rejected candidates. Run a bounded live smoke query and record actual provider status; failure is not a successful search. Discovery remains an explicit network command; rendering stays offline.
issues.negative: Inject timeout, HTTP 429, and malformed data. Preserve available results and a failure record; do not synthesize missing papers.

issues.title: Reconcile source identities and gate assisted extraction proposals
issues.problem: Title similarity and LLM confidence are insufficient for version reconciliation or semantic relation acceptance.
issues.deliverable: Add identifier-based reconciliation and a bounded interface for host-authored extraction candidates. Preserve conflicts, source access and abstentions. Provide a reproducible evaluation runner with honest provenance.
issues.acceptance: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_identity.py tests/test_extraction.py -q`. Same-title/different-DOI records stay separate; arXiv revisions group without losing versions; contradictory identifiers are flagged. Candidate gates abstain on unavailable text, missing locators, unknown comparison units and citation-only semantic claims. Publish an engineering-fixture evaluation manifest with per-type decision precision/coverage/abstention; label it explicitly as fixture validation, not independent semantic accuracy. Independent human labeling remains in #10.
issues.negative: Same-title different-DOI works must not merge automatically. Unknown cost units must not become an accepted bound improvement. Unavailable full text must remain unavailable.

issues.title: Run an independent map review and reading-task pilot
issues.problem: The flagship example has no external scholarly review or measured user outcomes.
issues.deliverable: Recruit real independent reviewers, document conflicts and disagreements, and run bounded reading tasks that measure source-checking accuracy and time.
issues.acceptance: Publish actual review references and anonymized study results with consent. Document participant counts, methods, failures, and baseline comparisons; do not replace missing observations with estimates. User decision on 2026-10-17: no participants or review materials are currently available. Keep this issue open until genuine external evidence exists. Software evaluation tooling and engineering fixtures are tracked separately and do not satisfy this issue.
issues.negative: Agent-generated reviewer names and self-assessed precision do not satisfy acceptance.

issues.title: Propose source-version-aware frontier updates
issues.problem: Current diffs compare map files but cannot reconstruct what was known at a historical cutoff.
issues.deliverable: Specify temporal semantics and implement update proposals that preserve source-version availability and unresolved conflicts.
issues.acceptance: Implement `tests/test_temporal_updates.py`; a revision published after a historical cutoff must be excluded or explicitly make reconstruction unavailable. Proposals must preserve old map files.
issues.negative: Filtering nodes by first publication alone must not be presented as an as-of snapshot. A critique must not automatically invalidate every descendant.

issues.title: Evaluate transfer beyond the flagship map
issues.problem: One quantum example does not establish that the workflow generalizes to other questions.
issues.deliverable: Produce a second quantum map from a single paper seed and rerun the non-quantum NMT map with the revised reading experience. Preserve source/version checks, domain-specific settings, and measured agent authoring/checking effort.
issues.acceptance: Publish both checked map inputs, research logs, validation/build records, and actual browser observations. Record observed effort and limitations, distinguishing agent work from external human review. Both maps must work with the same generic runtime. Human quality/transfer studies remain in #10.
issues.negative: Do not copy QSVT-specific settings into another domain or claim cross-domain quality from synthetic data.

issues.title: Start a research history from one topic or one paper
issues.problem: Users should not need to write a research specification, choose IDs, or fill JSON to invoke the skill.
issues.deliverable: Make the skill the primary product. Accept a short topic, DOI/arXiv link, paper title, or local paper. Infer a bounded brief, language and source budget; use host research tools to author the map. Add a deterministic start helper without pretending it performs research.
issues.acceptance: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_intake.py -q`. Topic and paper seeds produce empty drafts and useful research briefs, with preserved pinned versions and no network. Exercise one natural-language topic and one paper seed through real authoring/build/viewer runs.
issues.negative: A local/private PDF is not uploaded; an empty draft is not replaced with bundled content; a bare paper title is resolved before identity is asserted.

issues.title: Lead with a calm reading overview and reveal evidence on demand
issues.problem: The initial map presents a graph, filters, warnings and a full inspector together, leaving new researchers unsure where to begin.
issues.deliverable: Create a restrained overview with a concise source-linked narrative, a short reading entry point and a secondary explore view. Keep provenance, comparison and full exports one step away. Preserve old maps and keyboard access.
issues.acceptance: Build QSP, NMT and the new paper-seed map. In the actual browser, verify the initial overview has one primary reading action and no open inspector/filter panel; reveal the explorer, complete the route, recover empty filters, inspect source versions and export the complete input from a filtered view. Check desktop and narrow layout and record screenshots.
issues.negative: Simplification must not hide proposed status, invent turning points, truncate the exported dataset, break deep links, or remove source/version evidence.

issues.title: Offer equivalent English and Chinese READMEs with a clear skill-first quickstart
issues.problem: The repository currently has only an English README and exposes implementation commands before the simple user workflow.
issues.deliverable: Add README.zh-CN.md and reciprocal language links at the top. Both explain topic/paper inputs, skill installation, output navigation, honest boundaries and advanced CLI usage.
issues.acceptance: Follow both README paths from installation to topic/paper examples; verify reciprocal local links, equivalent commands and limitations, and include the Chinese README in the source distribution.
issues.negative: Language switching must resolve to real files; neither version may imply an autonomous hosted research service or completed external certification.

issues.title: Provide reproducible evaluation and consent-aware reading-study tools
issues.problem: External evaluation cannot yet run, and invented or self-assessed scientific scores would be misleading.
issues.deliverable: Provide extraction-gate evaluation and a reading-task study protocol/report tool. Require explicit provenance, consent, actual timings, paired baseline observations and source-check outcomes. Keep missing data visibly unavailable.
issues.acceptance: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_evaluation.py -q`. Valid labeled fixture decisions produce known per-type metrics; missing predictions, non-consented observations and duplicate participant/task rows are rejected. An empty study yields zero participants and unavailable metrics. Publish a blank study template and protocol without fabricated participants.
issues.negative: Engineering fixtures must not be labeled independent human review, and an empty study must not report perfect accuracy.
